comparison.objective: Hang two wine glasses upside down in an overhead stemware rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Grip thin stems, raise each foot above the lips, enter through the open end, slide along a channel, and release.
comparison.success_condition: Glasses hang straight with feet resting on both lips, still and clear; knockover zeros the trial.
comparison.reason: Channel threading and fragile-object suspension have no meaningful overlap with tool-seated stop adjustment or retained-motion testing.
